services.desc: Our Track is a recently surfaced 2 KM High Banked Lemans Style Go-Kart Track with 50 Karts reaching speeds up to 40KPH! Children must be 10 years old and 54" tall to drive alone. Children age 9 and under ride free with a paying adult on side-by-side two-seater karts. Fully lit track for exciting night racing! 12 Lap package is CASH ONLY - No Cards - Save the Processing Fees.
